prompt: Create a refined full-body anime illustration of an elegant young adult man with long pale blond hair tied in a low ponytail, fair skin, narrow calm eyes, and a gentle confident smile, standing on a sunlit wooden seaside veranda in autumn. He wears a traditional Japanese autumn kimono ensemble: a light gray layered kimono, black obi sash, dark deep-purple haori coat with wide sleeves, patterned inner lining showing gold geometric motifs and white chrysanthemum flowers. Add exactly 4 visible accessories: a white beaded necklace with one green pendant, a sheathed short sword tucked into the obi, a dark bamboo flute held loosely in his right hand, and white tabi socks with dark geta sandals. Pose him leaning casually against a pale wooden railing with his left hand resting on it, body angled slightly forward, head turned to the right as if looking toward the ocean. Set the background as a bright sparkling sea with distant low mountains, soft hazy sky, and a wooden pavilion structure with vertical posts and railings. Add exactly 8 visible red-orange maple leaves: two clusters framing the top left, one leaf near the upper center-left, two leaves drifting around the torso area, one near the right ocean area, one blurred leaf at the bottom left, and one small leaf near the lower right. Use a delicate shoujo / josei anime style with thin clean linework, soft watercolor-like shading, pastel whites and lavender grays, high-key backlighting, airy atmosphere, elegant fabric folds, and subtle motion in the haori hem. Vertical portrait composition, full body visible from head to sandals, no text, no watermark, no modern objects.

promptZh: 创作一张精致的全身动漫风格插画，描绘 一位优雅的中性风青年 站在初秋阳光明媚的海边木质走廊上。他身材高挑纤细，皮肤白皙，五官精致优雅，眼神狭长平静，留着一头 白金色 长发，扎成低侧马尾，脸颊两侧散落着柔和的发丝。他微微向右侧身，带着淡淡的从容微笑，散发出宁静的贵族气质。为他穿上传统的日本秋季正装：一件柔和的薰衣草灰和服，搭配宽大的黑色腰带、白色足袋和黑色木屐，肩上披着一件深茄紫色的羽织。羽织应轻轻飘动，露出一侧带有金色格纹、云朵图案和白色菊花的华丽内衬。胸前饰有一条白色珠串羽织绳，中间镶嵌着一颗深绿色宝石。他的一只手放松地握着一把闭合的深色折扇，另一只手轻搭在木质栏杆上；腰间别着一个短小的鞘状配饰或扇套。场景设定在褪色的浅色木质甲板上，背景是波光粼粼的大海和地平线上隐约可见的远岛，前景和左上方飘落着柔和的红枫叶。采用精致的日本乙女游戏 / 女性向插画风格，线条纤细干净，色彩呈半透明的粉彩色调，带有柔和的水彩感阴影、明亮的逆光、空气感氛围，以及细腻的衣物褶皱和优雅的服饰细节。构图为竖向肖像，全身居中，视角略低，充满白色的光影与海面波光，无文字，无水印，无多余角色。
